
    kind: str | None = None
    from_id: str | None = None
    to_id: str | None = None
    below: str | None = None

    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        """Whether no field narrows at all — a selection naming every edge."""
        return (
            self.kind is None
            and self.from_id is None
            and self.to_id is None
            and self.below is None
        )
